ValidationRule.description: Status can only changed to Under Review from Expired status.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( TEXT( PRIORVALUE( CLA_Status__c ) ) = 'Expired' , TEXT( CLA_Status__c ) <> 'Under Review', TEXT( CLA_Status__c ) <> 'Expired' )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Status can only changed to Under Review from Expired status.
